title: The size of the poset of compatible locally quasi-convex topologies on locally compact abelian groups
summary: For a Hausdorff locally quasi-convex abelian group $G$, let $\C(G)$ be the poset of all Hausdorff locally quasi-convex group topologies on its underlying group having the same continuous characters as $G$. We prove that, whenever $G$ is non-precompact, $\C(G)$ contains an order-isomorphic copy of $(\Pow(\cont),\subseteq)$, where $\cont=2^{\aleph_0}$. The embedding takes values between the Bohr topology and the original topology. Consequently, every infinite discrete abelian group $D$ satisfies $|\C(D)|=\width\C(D)=2^{2^{|D|}}$.
